report:
Fresh assessment of the complete current claim, one ordinary implementation association, three ordinary tests, and one TODO test. Verified byte equality of current sage-reflect/src/lib.rs and service_spec.rs against all three historical implementation/test source snapshots; the supplied prior independent review is baseline context, not the verdict. Read the full current implementation and associated test bodies.
Requirements are faithful derived ordinary structure, explicit semantic leaves, inline storage values, actual recursive reentry, bounded reflection, and immutable owned continuations without later database borrowing. ValueNode/ValueField, scalar strings, SymbolReference and continuation maps contain owned values; resolver methods return owned leaves. reflect_node enforces construction/depth limits; finish, bound_node/fields/items and continuation reservations bound visible root and retained pages; exhaustion explicitly truncates. continuations returns cloned owned pages, with no resolver or DB borrow retained in those values. Ptr and Slice dereference through the supplied stash; Stashed supplies its owning stash. reflect_stash_entry tracks active identities and removes each after traversal, permitting repeated nonrecursive edges.
node_budget_bounds_root_and_all_continuations recursively counts the visible tree and every retained page and asserts each aggregate <=8. repeated_arena_edges_are_reflected_inline requires two scalar 22 values and absence of stash identities, detecting mistaken shared-edge cycle handling. only_an_active_recursive_stash_edge_becomes_a_cycle asserts the exact Cycle identity on reentry (the inner closure must never run), then requires a scalar on a subsequent traversal, detecting failure to clear active state. These meaningful assertions establish their limited scenarios, not full product fidelity.
The service_spec TODO explicitly retains the prerequisite to associate and review complete derive-shape, semantic-link, wide-sequence, representative real IR, and continuation evidence (with overlap on already covered repeated-edge and cycle cases). This remains justified: three ordinary tests do not establish all ordinary shapes, semantic product leaves or DB-independent continuation behavior. Nearby unassociated derive/continuation/traversal tests are contextual only, not additional associated coverage. Accepting this unchanged deferral does not declare the entire guarantee implemented or adequately tested. All relied-on implementation helpers are within the initial whole-file fragment; review policy was additionally captured with review read. No source changes, behavioral tests or build were executed by this reviewer; coordinator-reported 321 tests and cargo build are separate historical execution evidence. No edits needed to current ordinary-plus-TODO accounting.
